summary.text: Pepper Snyder is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 50 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
She previously worked for 13 years in the benefit recovery unit of Indiana's Family and Social Services Administration.

paragraphs.text: Pepper Snyder graduated from Seeger Memorial Junior-Senior High School, and Ballotpedia lists her career experience as social services.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a wife of 30 years, mother of seven and grandmother of eight.
She said she worked in Benefit Recovery (SNAP, Medicaid and TANF fraud investigation) at FSSA for 13 years before resigning to care for her grandchildren.
Snyder named affordability, utility rates and energy policy, data-center development, healthcare access and tax relief for working families as her policy priorities.
